title: Passage between separably closed fields
statement:
Let $k\subseteq k'$ be an extension of fields [def-pc-field-extension] with $k$ and $k'$ separably closed [def-pc-separably-closed], and let $\iota:\operatorname{Spec}k'\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be the induced morphism of spectra [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $C$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] whose structure morphism $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and whose underlying topological space has Krull dimension $\dim C\le1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] (the empty scheme is allowed). Let $C_{k'}=C\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k'$ be the base change of $C$ along $\iota$ [def-pc-base-change], with projection $\pi:C_{k'}\to C$. Let $F$ be a torsion abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf] on the small etale site $C_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with inverse image $\pi^{-1}F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Assume the following hypothesis (H) (the assertion of the proposition on algebraically closed extensions, prop-weil-pbc-algebraically-closed-extension, in the precise form of Step 1 of prop-weil-pbc-proper-curve-sepclosed-invariance): for every extension $K\subseteq K'$ of algebraically closed fields [def-weil-algebraic-closure], every scheme $D$ over $K$ whose structure morphism $D\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ is proper and whose underlying space has $\dim D\le1$, and every torsion abelian sheaf $G$ on $D_{\Et}$, the pullback map [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] along the projection $p:D_{K'}=D\times_{\operatorname{Spec}K}\operatorname{Spec}K'\to D$ of the base change, $p^*:H^q(D_{\Et},G)\to H^q((D_{K'})_{\Et},p^{-1}G)$, is an isomorphism for every $q\ge0$. Then for every $q\ge0$ the pullback map along $\pi$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]

$$
 \pi^*:H^q(C_{\Et},F)\longrightarrow H^q((C_{k'})_{\Et},\pi^{-1}F)
$$

between the etale cohomology groups [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Use sepClosed_geometric_comparison to choose algebraically closed fields, a proper curve b, a cartesian bottom square, and universal-homeomorphism vertical maps p and p' with p' >> iota' = a >> p. This step involves no cohomology hypothesis.

Pull back the module sheaf F along p; it remains torsion. Apply the algebraically closed hypothesis H to the proper curve b and this sheaf. Transport the resulting bijectivity through pullback_forget_modules_iso using naturality of cohomologyMap; obtain bijectivity of the bottom cohomology map on the abelian pullback p^*F.

Both vertical cohomology maps are bijective by cohomologyMap_bijective. The composition isomorphisms upperStarComp and cohomologyPullbackFunctorial identify the two composites around the commuting scheme square, transported to the same pullback sheaf. Compose the bottom bijection with the left vertical bijection and the inverse composition isomorphism, and cancel the bijective right vertical comparison to obtain bijectivity of the original map.

split_report.summary: Statement made precise after prop-weil-pbc-proper-curve-sepclosed-invariance (which uses it in its Step 2): the map is the pullback pi^* of def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback along the projection pi:C_{k'}->C onto pi^{-1}F, and the hypothesis (H) is written out in full as the algebraically closed case (prop-weil-pbc-algebraically-closed-extension in the form of Step 1 of the user node; named in the text, not a dependency, since it is a hypothesis). The single imported step was replaced by ten steps following the proof of Stacks Lemma 0A5E: characteristic 0 (elementary, separably closed = algebraically closed), compatible algebraic closures via the relative algebraic closure of k in an algebraic closure of k' (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-relative-algebraic-closure-algclosed), pure inseparability (lem-pc-kbar-pure-insep), universal homeomorphisms rho, sigma (lem-pc-homeo-pure-insep, quantified over all k-schemes, plus cartesian-square pasting; no new node needed), the pullback isomorphisms (prop-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-topos, Stacks 03SI), the hypotheses of (H) for C_{kbar} over kbar (proper base change, dimension through the homeomorphism, inverse image of torsion), the identification of the two base changes to kbar', the bottom arrow and the commutative square through the composition clause of lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial, and two out of three. The pointer dependencies lemma-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-coverings and lemma-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-site-equivalence (used only inside 03SI) were dropped.
